description: This file defines a custom extension for a task list component in a rich text editor, including attributes, rendering, commands, node views, plugins, input rules, and keyboard shortcuts. It is part of the Notesnook project and integrates with ProseMirror and Tiptap.

classes.name: TaskListNode
classes.description: A custom extension of the TaskList node with additional attributes, commands, node view, and plugins for enhanced task list functionality within the editor.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines custom attributes for the task list node, including stats, title, and readonly status, with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies the HTML tag and priority used to parse task list nodes from HTML.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how the task list node is rendered as HTML, including classes and attributes.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides custom commands for toggling the task list, with permission checks and selection handling.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom node view for the task list, with update logic based on attribute and child count changes.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds ProseMirror plugins for handling drop behavior, reactive state management, and synchronization of task list states.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules to convert specific input patterns into task lists, with permission checks.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Defines keyboard shortcuts for toggling the task list.
